key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut that shows or hides the search window. An empty list disables it.

key.name: max-results
key.description: How many results the search window shows at most.

key.name: panel-width
key.description: Width of the search window in logical pixels. It is clamped to the monitor width.

key.name: top-offset
key.description: Distance between the top of the monitor and the search window, as a percentage of the monitor height.

key.name: fuzzy-matching
key.summary: How fuzzy app and file name matching is
key.description: “strict” matches the start of a name or word, “normal” any part of a name, “loose” also skips characters in between (“vsc” finds Visual Studio Code).

key.name: file-contents
key.description: Also match text inside indexed files. Slower than matching names.

key.name: home-currency
key.description: “100 eur” and “€50” convert to it, and “$” means it when it is a dollar. “auto” uses the currency of the system locale’s region (USD if unknown).

key.name: run-commands
key.description: When the first word is a program on PATH, show a row that runs the line.

key.name: command-enter
key.description: “terminal” opens a terminal, so a mistyped command can be seen and stopped; “background” runs it silently. Ctrl+Enter does the other.

key.name: prefix-agent
key.summary: Prefixes for the AI agent only

key.name: prefix-terminal
key.summary: Prefixes for running a command in the terminal

key.name: offline-mode
key.description: Nothing leaves the computer: no weather, exchange-rate or time-zone requests, no results from apps' search providers, no web search rows. Saved exchange rates are still used.

key.name: debug-timing
key.description: For profiling: log when each provider answers, how many renders a search took and their time. Never logs the query. Not shown in Preferences.

key.name: show-preview
key.description: Toggled with Ctrl+P in the search window.

key.name: preview-position
key.description: “end” puts the preview after the results (right in left-to-right languages), “start” before them.

key.name: clipboard-history
key.description: Keep a list of copied text, shown by searching “clip”. Copies that password managers mark as secret, and ones that look like tokens, keys or card numbers, are skipped.

key.name: clipboard-persist
key.description: Save the clipboard history so it survives screen locks and logging out. When off, the history lives only in memory.

key.name: clipboard-size
key.description: How many copied items to remember.

key.name: web-search-engine
key.description: Search engine used by the web search row. “custom” uses web-search-url.

key.name: web-search-url
key.description: An http or https URL where %s is replaced by the query, used when web-search-engine is “custom”.

key.name: weather-city
key.description: City used when searching “weather” without a city. It is sent to Open-Meteo only when you search for weather.

key.name: weather-units
key.description: “metric” for °C, “imperial” for °F.

key.name: ai-agent
key.description: Agent CLI opened by “ask <prompt>”.

key.name: terminal
key.description: Command that runs the arguments after it in a terminal, e.g. “kitty” or “ptyxis --new-window --”. Empty uses the system default.
